---
title: "After the course"
---
The [companion curriculum](../../companion/index.qmd) covers the material that three days can only mention in passing, in modules that each stand on their own, so take the one you need and leave the rest. The section "Going further" at the end of your report holds six more exercises that run in the workspace: a sweep of a whole decision, the analysis of 456AP refitted on the file of the analysts, the checks that the curve leaves out, the same question asked of later surveys, the groups behind the claim, and three ways of computing the standard error.

| If you want | Read |
|---|---|
| The ideas behind what you just did, and the arguments now being made against them | [The multiverse and its critics](../../companion/multiverse.qmd) |
| Censoring, the life table, person-period data, the discrete-time logit and complementary log-log models, competing risks, and period against cohort, worked on this case | [Event-history analysis](../../companion/event-history.qmd) |
| The graph work at a slower pace: confounders, mediators and colliders, selection, and a graph for a question of your own | [Causal graphs and adjustment sets](../../companion/dags.qmd) |
| The logit against the linear probability model, and how to read odds ratios against percentage points | [Binary outcomes](../../companion/binary-outcomes.qmd) |
| Survey weights and errors that follow the design of a survey | [Weights](../../companion/weighting.qmd) |
| R from the beginning | [Getting started with R](../../companion/intro-r.qmd) |
| The document format in which your report is written | [Quarto and reproducible documents](../../companion/quarto.qmd) |
| To archive and version the report that you wrote | [Reproducibility repositories](../../companion/repositories.qmd), then [Git and GitHub](../../companion/git-github.qmd) |
| The replication and the five analyses in their own words | The SCORE project of the paper at [osf.io/kv38j](https://osf.io/kv38j/), the replication with its report, script, data dictionary and person-month file at [osf.io/u8x9s](https://osf.io/u8x9s/), and the Multi100 component with one sub-component for each analyst at [osf.io/b69nv](https://osf.io/b69nv/) |
| The survey itself | The NSFG pages of the National Center for Health Statistics at [cdc.gov/nchs/nsfg](https://www.cdc.gov/nchs/nsfg/), where the public-use files of every cycle can be downloaded without registration |
| The whole story of the case, with the sources | [The case study](../../cases/cohabitation/index.qmd), whose sections 3 to 6 now tell you what you found in Task 3, and the [resources page](../../resources.qmd) |
